title: Module 2 — Technical content generation output
description: Output envelope of 02-technical-content-generation. Replaces the seven flat narrative keys with a keyed `sections` map plus a `tables` map, because the chapter catalog has ~60 render keys and ~25 tables and a flat top-level key per section stopped scaling. Which keys are present depends on the resolved proposal_config (tier + client profile) and the request's scope_of_supply. Content is produced by five stages — A1 engineering, A2 execution, A3 commercial, A5 clause selection (deterministic), A4 QA review — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

proposal_config.description: The resolved per-client config this run used (schemas/proposal-config.schema.json). Passed through so Module 4 renders against exactly the same chapter set that Module 2 wrote for.

sections.description: Render key -> plain text body. Keys are chapter or section ids from schemas/chapter-catalog.json. Format is the same contract as before: no markdown, paragraphs separated by a blank line, list items as '•  item'. The render core turns each into {parrafos, bullets} via parseNarrative(). Boilerplate resolved by A5 is merged in here too, under the same keys — the template cannot tell generated text from clause text, which is deliberate.

tables.description: Table id -> array of row objects, keyed by the column names declared in chapter-catalog.json `tables`. Prose cannot carry a table, so these come back as real JSON from the agents rather than as bullet text to be parsed. Row values are strings; the render core does not reformat them (except money, which is calculated, not generated).

sections_generated.description: Render keys that came back with content (traceability).

agents_run.description: Which stages actually executed, in order.

clauses_applied.description: Ids of the boilerplate snippets A5 selected from the client's Proposal Config sheet. Lets a reviewer see which contract text went out without diffing the document.

qa.description: A4's review of the assembled draft.

patches_applied.description: How many section bodies A4 rewrote.

grounded_on.description: Reference-doc names used to ground the generation (traceability).
